pages.text: Removes cursed Flim-Flam lore from items. Combine the eraser with any item that carries epic lore in a crafting grid to strip the fake enchantment text and restore a clean tooltip.
The eraser has limited durability. It clears both OpenCubes epic lore data and vanilla lore lines when present. Useful after pranks, villager trades, or unstable enchantment mishaps.
